id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying queries blocked by a missing reservation

review.posthog_relevance: BigQuery warehouse ingestion connector reliability and user remediation
review.reason: Adds a permanent, non-retryable error classification for BigQuery billing/capacity failures, preventing unnecessary retries and providing a clear user action. P1.F1.H1 introduces the error entry and remediation message; P1.F2.H1 adds the corresponding unit test. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk descriptions; no independent verification of actual production behavior or complete implementation context.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error entry and its user-facing remediation message, and adds a corresponding unit test.
observations.code_quote: "project does not have the reservation in the data region or no slots are configured": "BigQuery couldn't run a query for this source because your Google Cloud project has neither on-demand pricing nor a flat-rate reservation configured for the queried region. Please enable on-demand pricing or create a BigQuery reservation for that region (https://console.cloud.google.com/bigquery/admin/reservations), then re-enable the source.",
observations.posthog_connection: This change prevents the BigQuery warehouse ingestion connector from repeatedly retrying a query that will never succeed due to missing billing or capacity reservation. It distinguishes this permanent failure from transient slot shortages, allowing the system to stop retrying and present a clear action to the user. This improves reliability and user experience for warehouse sources

observations.behavior: Adds a unit test asserting that the specific error message is recognized as non-retryable.
